name: guerrilla_rotate
headline: guerrilla_rotate: Claude Code skill for marketing
short_description: Implements the Guerrilla Marketing technique of side-by-side content/view testing (aka: A/B testing and split testing)
author: smathy

sections.overview:
The guerrilla_rotate skill implements A/B testing and split testing methodologies within the Guerrilla Marketing framework. It enables side-by-side content and view testing to compare performance of different marketing variations. This skill allows marketers to test multiple versions simultaneously and measure their effectiveness against each other.
Test two different email subject lines to determine which generates higher open rates
Compare landing page layouts side-by-side to identify which drives more conversions
Evaluate different ad copy variations to measure click-through rate performance
Split website visitor traffic between two homepage designs to measure engagement differences
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/smathy/guerrilla_rotate`
sections.usage:
```
Help me design a guerrilla marketing campaign to test two versions of [CONTENT_TYPE] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Provide a detailed plan for distributing [CONTENT_VERSION_A] and [CONTENT_VERSION_B] to different audience segments, and outline how to measure and compare their performance using [DATA_METRICS].
```
